summary: Hardcoded bearer-token authentication bypass in exported auth middleware
details: The exported createAuthMiddleware in @decido/backend-core unconditionally accepts two hardcoded bearer tokens ('mock-admin-token' and 'mock-token-123') and, when either is presented, populates req.user with an ADMIN or STUDENT role loaded from the database, then calls next(). The bypass is not gated by NODE_ENV, a test-mode flag, or any runtime configuration, and the tokens ship in the published tarball. Any Express service that mounts createAuthMiddleware / createAuthRouter as its authentication layer can be accessed as an administrator by any remote caller who sends the token in an Authorization: Bearer header.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
